desc: Ideate candidate approaches and select safest primary approach.
Confirm final complexity is O(45 * n) time and O(1) extra space.
Implement a compact residue-DP solution in the starter code using cnt[d] arrays for d=1..9, fresh arrays per character, and no precomputation/flattening.
Ensure zero-ending substrings are still updated in the DP state for future extensions.
Verify the three sample tests and edge cases such as all zeros, single digits, many leading zeros, all ones, and long strings.
